$comment: CROSS-ENGINE CONFORMANCE VECTORS — authoritative source of truth for the A6 trigger
identity. BOTH engines load THIS file and must pass every vector:
- framework (Py):  orchestration/common (celpy side) — mirrored test, added when F0 unblocks.
Contract:  canonical_json = RFC 8785 (JCS);  orch_sha1(s) = lowercase-hex SHA-1 over the
UTF-8 bytes of s;  dag_run_id = orch_sha1(dag_id + canonical_json(conf))[:16].
dag_id is concatenated directly to canonical_json(conf) with NO separator.
To ADD a vector: write conf (any key order), compute expected_jcs by the JCS rules, then
Keep ASCII-only unless the number/unicode edge is deliberately being pinned on both engines.

spec.orch_sha1: lowercase hex SHA-1 over UTF-8 bytes

vectors.name: flat-string-keys-reordered
vectors.note: keys given out of order; JCS must sort portfolio_id < reporting_date

vectors.name: integer-and-boolean
vectors.note: integer serialized without decimal/exponent; boolean literal; keys sorted

vectors.name: nested-object-and-array
vectors.note: nested object keys sorted (x<y); array order preserved [3,1,2]; top-level a<z

vectors.name: empty-string-and-null
vectors.note: empty string retained; JSON null retained; keys sorted a<b
